Description (SPA): Identificador surrogate generado por SQLite para cada registro de candidatura cargado.
Description (ENG): SQLite-generated surrogate identifier for each loaded candidate record.
Notes: Not present in source catalogs; created in the warehouse.

Description (SPA): Tipo de eleccion asociado al catalogo de candidaturas.
Description (ENG): Election type associated with the candidate catalog.
Notes: This table is loaded from candidate catalogs when available. Populated for 2015, 2021, and 2024 only; not populated for 1994/2000/2006/2012/2018 additions.

Description (SPA): Clave normalizada del partido, coalicion u opcion electoral de la candidatura.
Description (ENG): Normalized party, coalition, or vote-option key for the candidate.
Values / Domain: Values from dim_party.party_key when matching party keys exist.
Notes: Links candidate catalog rows to vote-option keys.
Candidate catalogs are state/district scoped for diputaciones.

Description (SPA): Nombre de entidad federativa en el catalogo de candidaturas.
Description (ENG): State name in the candidate catalog.
Notes: Useful for audit and readability; id_estado is safer for joins.

Description (SPA): Distrito electoral federal de la candidatura.
Description (ENG): Federal electoral district for the candidacy.
Notes: Part of the natural grain for diputaciones candidate catalogs.

Description (SPA): Nombre de la candidatura propietaria o principal.
Notes: Included in the uniqueness constraint because multiple rows can share party/state/district context in source catalogs.

Description (SPA): Nombre de la candidatura suplente cuando el catalogo la reporta.
Description (ENG): Substitute candidate name when reported by the catalog.
Notes: Available in 2015/2021 candidate catalogs when provided.

Description (SPA): Etiqueta original de partido politico o candidatura en el catalogo.
Description (ENG): Original political party or candidacy label in the catalog.

Description (SPA): Votacion ganadora reportada en el catalogo de candidaturas, cuando existe.
Description (ENG): Winning vote total reported in the candidate catalog, when present.
Notes: Warehouse schema casts to INTEGER; malformed/missing source values load as NULL.

Description (SPA): Porcentaje ganador reportado en el catalogo de candidaturas, cuando existe.
Description (ENG): Winning percentage reported in the candidate catalog, when present.
Notes: Warehouse schema casts to REAL; formatting differences in source catalogs can produce NULL.

Description (SPA): Marca de tiempo de insercion generada por SQLite.
